Team —

Quick housekeeping ahead of the Friday submission window. I want to run a tight 15‑minute "cleanroom" to lock all stage assignments and evidence for the accounts below. Please read, update, and then join the 15m at 09:15 PT on Friday if you own any of the listed lanes.

Action items (please complete before the call):
- Update Q3-pipeline-cleanroom-v1.xlsx (tab: YOUR_ACCOUNTS) with current stage + confidence % + next milestone date.
- Attach minimal evidence (one line per account) in the Evidence column. If evidence is in Drive, paste link.
- For any >$250k deals, add a one‑line blocker and required exec action.

Agenda for 15m huddle (9:15–9:30 PT, Fri):
1) Rapid lane rollcall (owner states: stage/confidence) — 6m
2) Top 3 late-stage blockers — 4m
3) Evidence sanity check and final deck handoff — 3m
2) Confirm submission roster and who hits turn‑in — 2m

Attachments: Q3-pipeline-cleanroom-v1.xlsx (master sheet), forecast-evidence-checklist.pdf
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-cleanroom-slate
Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/weekly-15m-hygiene

I expect concise updates — one sentence per account. If you can't make the slot, ping @marissa with your completed tab and a short note.

Thanks,
Markus
